title: L2-L3, L3-L4, L4-L5 facet force at 15 Nm extension + 700 N (pressure film, intact)

quantity.name: facet force
quantity.definition: facet force = contact area x mean pressure from multi-grade PressureX film (per facet); mean +- SD of 7 specimens

source.authors: Wiseman CM, Lindsey DP, Fredrick AD, Yerby SA
source.sample: 7 human cadaveric L2-L5 spines; muscle removed, ligaments intact, left and right L2-L3, L3-L4, L4-L5 facet capsules removed

protocol.summary: L2 and L5 potted in PMMA in an MTS multi-channel spine fixture. Preload 700 N until axial displacement stabilised (15-60 min). Test: 700 N axial compression at 25 N/s (linear actuator at cranial end), then 15 Nm extension at 0.25 Nm/s via rotational actuators at cranial and caudal ends; peak held 60 s. Film (ultra-low to medium grades) in left and right facets at each level; test repeated with higher-grade film if saturated. Then X STOP at L3-L4 (not extracted).
how_to_simulate: Model L2-L5 with ligaments, facet capsules removed; fix L5
Apply 700 N axial compression (follower or vertical at L2) then a 15 Nm pure extension moment
Report facet contact force per facet at L2-L3, L3-L4 and L4-L5 (N)
protocol.notes: Film error ~+-15% in pressure. Implanted (X STOP) values outside card scope.

extraction.check_notes: Review values (76.7+/-49.5, 83.2+/-80.2, 72.5+/-70.7) confirmed as intact mean +/- SD; n = 7; capsules removed.
